mn12:43.1: yo kho maṃ sāriputta evaṃ jānantaṃ evaṃ passantaṃ evaṃ vadeyya
mn12:43.2: natthi samaṇassa gotamassa uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanaviseso
mn12:43.3: takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃsānucaritaṃ sayaṃ paṭibhānanti
mn12:43.4: taṃ sāriputta vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
mn12:43.5: seyyathāpi sāriputta bhikkhu sīlasampanno samādhisampanno paññāsampanno diṭṭheva dhamme aññaṃ ārādheyya evaṃ sampadamidaṃ sāriputta vadāmi.
mn12:43.6: taṃ vācaṃ appahāya taṃ cittaṃ appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ appaṭinissajjitvā yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
mn12:44.1: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ sāriputta caturaṅgasamannāgataṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritā.
mn12:44.2: tapassissudaṃ homi paramatapassī lūkho sudaṃ homi paramalūkho jegucchī sudaṃ homi paramajegucchī pavivitto sudaṃ homi paramapavivitto.
mn12:45.1: tatrassu me idaṃ sāriputta tapassitāya hoti acelako homi muttācāro hatthāvalekhano na ehibhadantiko na tiṭṭhabhadantiko na abhihataṃ na uddissa kataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyāmi.
mn12:45.2: so na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhāmi na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhāmi na eḷakamantaraṃ na maṇḍamantaraṃ na mūsalamantaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na purisantaragatāya na saṅkittīsu na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakaṃ pivāmi.
mn12:45.3: so ekāgāriko vā homi ekālopiko dvāgāriko vā homi dvālopiko …pe… sattāgāriko vā homi sattālopiko.
mn12:45.4: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpemi dvīhipi dattīhi yāpemi …pe… sattahipi yāpemi
mn12:45.5: ekāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāremi dvīhikampi āhāraṃ āhāremi …pe… sattāhikampi āhāraṃ āhāremi iti evarūpaṃ aḍḍhamāsikampi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogamanuyutto viharāmi.
mn12:45.6: so sākabhakkho vā homi sāmākabhakkho vā homi nīvārabhakkho vā homi daddulabhakkho vā homi haṭabhakkho vā homi kaṇabhakkho vā homi ācāmabhakkho vā homi piññākabhakkho vā homi tiṇabhakkho vā homi gomayabhakkho vā homi vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpemi pavattaphalabhojī.

mn12:45.13: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto viharāmi.
mn12:46.1: tatrassu me idaṃ sāriputta lūkhasmiṃ hoti.
mn12:46.2: nekavassagaṇikaṃ rajojallaṃ kāye sannicitaṃ hoti pappaṭikajātaṃ.
mn12:46.3: seyyathāpi sāriputta tiṇḍukakhānu nekavassagaṇiko sannicito hoti pappaṭikajāto evamevassu me sāriputta nekavassagaṇikaṃ rajojallaṃ kāye sannicitaṃ hoti pappaṭikajātaṃ.
mn12:46.4: tassa mayhaṃ sāriputta na evaṃ hoti
mn12:46.5: aho vatāhaṃ imaṃ rajojallaṃ pāṇinā parimajjeyyaṃ. aññe vā pana me imaṃ rajojallaṃ pāṇinā parimajjeyyunti
mn12:47.1: tatrassu me idaṃ sāriputta jegucchismiṃ hoti.
mn12:47.2: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta satova abhikkamāmi sato paṭikkamāmi. yāva udakabindumhipi me dayā paccupaṭṭhitā hoti
mn12:47.3: māhaṃ khuddake pāṇe visamagate saṅghātaṃ āpādesinti.
mn12:48.1: tatrassu me idaṃ sāriputta pavivittasmiṃ hoti.
mn12:48.2: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta aññataraṃ araññāyatanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā viharāmi.
mn12:48.3: yadā passāmi gopālakaṃ vā pasupālakaṃ vā tiṇahārakaṃ vā kaṭṭhahārakaṃ vā vanakammikaṃ vā vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ papatāmi
mn12:48.5: mā maṃ te addasaṃsu ahañca mā te addasanti.
mn12:48.6: seyyathāpi sāriputta āraññako migo manusse disvā vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ papatati
mn12:48.7: evameva kho ahaṃ sāriputta yadā passāmi gopālakaṃ vā pasupālakaṃ vā tiṇahārakaṃ vā kaṭṭhahārakaṃ vā vanakammikaṃ vā vanena vanaṃ gahanena gahanaṃ ninnena ninnaṃ thalena thalaṃ papatāmi
mn12:48.9: mā maṃ te addasaṃsu ahañca mā te addasanti.
mn12:49.1: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta ye te gotthā paṭṭhitagāvo apagatagopālā tattha catukuṇḍiko upasaṅkamitvā yāni tāni vacchakānaṃ taruṇakānaṃ dhenupakānaṃ gomayāni tāni sudaṃ āhāremi.
mn12:49.2: yāvakīvañca me sāriputta sakaṃ muttakarīsaṃ apariyādinnaṃ hoti sakaṃyeva sudaṃ muttakarīsaṃ āhāremi.
mn12:50.1: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta aññataraṃ bhiṃsanakaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ ajjhogāhetvā viharāmi.
mn12:50.2: tatrassudaṃ sāriputta bhiṃsanakassa vanasaṇḍassa bhiṃsanakatasmiṃ hoti.
mn12:50.3: yokoci avītarāgo taṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ pavisati yebhuyyena lomāni haṃsanti.
mn12:50.4: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta yā tā rattiyo sītā hemantikā antaraṭṭhakā himapātasamayā tathārūpāsu rattīsu rattiṃ abbhokāse viharāmi divā vanasaṇḍe
mn12:50.5: gimhānaṃ pacchime māse divā abbhokāse viharāmi rattiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
mn12:50.6: apissu maṃ sāriputta ayaṃ anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhāsi pubbe assutapubbā
mn12:51.1: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta susāne seyyaṃ kappemi chavaṭṭhikāni upadhāya.
mn12:51.2: apissu maṃ sāriputta gomaṇḍalā upasaṅkamitvā oṭṭhubhentipi omuttentipi paṃsukenapi okiranti kaṇṇasotesupi salākaṃ pavesenti.
mn12:51.3: na kho panāhaṃ sāriputta abhijānāmi tesu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā.
mn12:52.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn12:52.5: te kolampi khādanti kolacuṇṇampi khādanti kolodakampi pivanti
mn12:52.7: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ sāriputta ekaṃyeva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āharitā.
mn12:52.8: siyā kho pana te sāriputta evamassa
mn12:52.9: mahā nūna tena samayena kolo ahosīti.
mn12:52.10: na kho panetaṃ sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn12:52.11: tadāpi etaparamoyeva kolo ahosi seyyathāpi etarahi.
mn12:52.12: tassa mayhaṃ sāriputta ekaṃyeva kolaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato adhimattakasīmānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.
mn12:52.13: seyyathāpi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kālāpabbāni vā evamevassu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.14: seyyathāpi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ evamevassu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.15: seyyathāpi nāma vaṭṭanāvaḷī evamevassu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako unnatāvanato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.16: seyyathāpi nāma jarasālāya gopāṇasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti evamevassu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.17: seyyathāpi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti evamevassu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.18: seyyathāpi nāma tittikālābu āmakacchinno vātātapena saṃphusito hoti sammilāto evamevassu me sīsacchavi saṃphusitā hoti sammilātā tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.19: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta udaracchaviṃ parimasissāmīti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parimasissāmīti udaracchaviṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi yāvassu me sāriputta udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.20: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmīti tatutheva avakujjo papatāmi tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn12:52.21: so kho ahaṃ sāriputta tameva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anomajjāmi. tassa mayhaṃ sāriputta pāṇinā gattāni anomajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāyevappāhāratāya.

mn12:56.1: tāyapi kho ahaṃ sāriputta ariyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamiṃ uttari manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ
mn12:56.3: imissāyeva ariyāya paññāya anadhigamā yāyaṃ ariyā paññā adhigatā ariyā niyyānikā niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāya.
mn12:57.1: santi pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn12:57.3: na kho paneso sāriputta saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā aññatra suddhāvāsehi devehi
mn12:57.4: suddhāvāse cāhaṃ sāriputta deve saṃsareyyaṃ nayimaṃ lokaṃ puna āgaccheyyaṃ.
mn12:58.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn12:58.3: na kho panesā sāriputta upapatti sulabharūpā yā mayā anuppannapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā aññatra suddhāvāsehi devehi
mn12:58.4: suddhāvāse cāhaṃ sāriputta deve upapajjeyyaṃ nayimaṃ lokaṃ puna āgaccheyyaṃ.
mn12:59.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn12:59.3: na kho paneso sāriputta āvāso sulabharūpo yo mayā anāvuṭṭhapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā aññatra suddhāvāsehi devehi
mn12:59.4: suddhāvāse cāhaṃ sāriputta deve āvaseyyaṃ nayimaṃ lokaṃ puna āgaccheyyaṃ.
mn12:60.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn12:60.3: na kho paneso sāriputta yañño sulabharūpo yo mayā ayiṭṭhapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā tañca kho raññā vā satā khattiyena muddhāvasittena brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.
mn12:61.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn12:61.3: na kho paneso sāriputta aggi sulabharūpo yo mayā apariciṇṇapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā tañca kho raññā vā satā khattiyena muddhāvasittena brāhmaṇena vā mahāsālena.
mn12:62.1: santi kho pana sāriputta eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn12:62.2: yāvadevāyaṃ bhavaṃ puriso daharo hoti yuvā susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā tāvadeva paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgato hoti
mn12:62.3: yato ca kho ayaṃ bhavaṃ puriso jiṇṇo hoti vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto asītiko vā navutiko vā vassasatiko vā jātiyā atha tamhā paññāveyyattiyā parihāyatīti.
mn12:62.4: na kho panetaṃ sāriputta evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
mn12:62.5: ahaṃ kho pana sāriputta etarahi jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto asītiko me vayo vattati.
mn12:62.6: idhassu me sāriputta cattāro sāvakā vassasatāyukā vassasatajīvino paramāya satiyā ca gatiyā ca dhitiyā ca samannāgatā paramena ca paññāveyyattiyena
mn12:62.7: seyyathāpi sāriputta daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katupāsano lahukena asanena appakasireneva tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya
mn12:62.8: evaṃ adhimattasatimanto evaṃ adhimattagatimanto evaṃ adhimattadhitimanto evaṃ paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgatā
mn12:62.9: te maṃ catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ upādāyupādāya pañhaṃ puccheyyuṃ puṭṭho puṭṭho cāhaṃ tesaṃ byākareyyaṃ byākatañca me byākatato dhāreyyuṃ na ca maṃ dutiyakaṃ uttariṃ paṭipuccheyyuṃ
mn12:62.10: aññatra asita pīta khāyita sāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddā kilamathapaṭivinodanā apariyādinnāyevassa sāriputta tathāgatassa dhammadesanā apariyādinnaṃyevassa tathāgatassa dhammapadabyañjanaṃ apariyādinnaṃyevassa tathāgatassa pañhāpaṭibhānaṃ.
mn12:62.11: atha me te cattāro sāvakā vassasatāyukā vassasatajīvino vassasatassa accayena kālaṃ kareyyuṃ.
mn12:62.12: mañcakena cepi maṃ sāriputta pariharissatha nevatthi tathāgatassa paññāveyyattiyassa aññathattaṃ.
mn12:63.1: yaṃ kho taṃ sāriputta sammā vadamāno vadeyya
mn12:63.2: asammohadhammo satto loke uppanno bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti. mameva taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
mn12:63.3: asammohadhammo satto loke uppanno bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
mn12:64.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgasamālo bhagavato piṭṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vījayamāno.
mn12:64.2: atha kho āyasmā nāgasamālo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn12:64.4: apica me bhante imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā lomāni haṭṭhāni
mn12:64.6: tasmātiha tvaṃ nāgasamāla imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ lomahaṃsanapariyāyotveva naṃ dhārehīti.
mn12:64.8: attamano āyasmā nāgasamālo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
